pattern: Decorative placeholders (aria-hidden) inside a region marked aria-busy, with a separate status message.
focus: Not focusable. Placeholders never receive focus.
notes: Placeholders are hidden from assistive technology; the region should contain a visually hidden status (for example a Spinner) that announces loading.
The pulse animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion and animation: none.
knownCaveats: aria-busy support varies across screen readers; the status message is the reliable announcement.
